entries.zh: 双手捧持；捧（用双手托着拿）
entries.en: to hold or carry something in both hands; to bear in cupped palms
entries.notes: 主义据 L'traer en ambas manos'+H'捧'清晰，因 M 声调号污损（T99）依规降为低置信

entries.en: to drag, pull along; to tow
entries.notes: 西语 delos cabecones 难解（疑为拖拽相关短语之讹读），拖曳义据 H'拖'/M'toa'；M 声调号污损（T99）依规降级

entries.en: to take/carry off by force; to seize, plunder
entries.notes: 主义据 L'traer por fuerza'+H'掠'+M'liag'清晰，唯 M 尾词 prendis（疑西班牙语 prendas'财物'）未得确解

entries.en: to pass on, relay, convey (word)
entries.notes: M 栏有残缺（[残]）且声调号污损（T99）；西语 recand 疑为 recado（口信）残字，传/转达义据 H'傳'

entries.en: to fetch and bring (go get/catch it and bring it)
to bring (along); to carry here

entries.zh: 捋鬚（辣鬚）；用手捋过胡须
entries.en: to run the hand along the beard; to stroke one's beard

entries.zh: 打报；报信（连连送来消息）
entries.en: to bring news, one report after another; to keep bringing word
to pass on news; to convey word
to turn (a cart/vehicle) around; to turn back
entries.notes: 西语 recador 及 '-in chuan' 难解；M 栏残缺（[残]）且声调污损（T99），掉转义据 H'車轉'暂定，释义存疑

entries.zh: 穿孝服；服期服之丧（一年之丧）
entries.en: to wear mourning (the one-year ji-fu mourning); to be in mourning
entries.notes: 西语 lano luv 疑为 el luto（丧服/居丧）之讹读，丧服义据 H'期服'（传统五服之一年丧服）与 M quy huy

entries.en: [original damaged/illegible; meaning uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语 moviis/monico 不可解，H'糸厶'字形不成词，M'chua bvi'未得对应词，材料不足

entries.zh: 怀抱小孩（抱在胸前怀里）
entries.en: to carry a small child in one's bosom/at the breast

entries.zh: 取回；带回（往返一趟拿回来）
entries.en: to bring something back; to fetch and return with it
entries.notes: H'到頭'疑为'倒頭'（倒置义）与西语 de buelta（往返/取回）两解并存，取回义赖推断

entries.en: to carry/labor under an illness; to be (long) sick
entries.notes: M'sa ge'与 H'拖病'读音不甚吻合，带病义据 L'traer enfermedad'+H'拖病'

entries.en: to deliver/carry letters; to convey correspondence
to deliver letters (Hokkien phoe 'letter')

entries.zh: 换茶；再沏一道茶（第二次上茶）
entries.en: to bring fresh tea; to serve tea a second time
entries.notes: 换茶义据 H'換茶'+L'segunda vez'清晰，因 M 声调号污损（T99）依规降级

entries.en: [original partly illegible; meaning uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语仅 retrato（画像）与 movado（疑 mareado'晕眩'）可辨，H'眩伊'/M'hin y'未能通解

entries.zh: 活动手脚；转动（病人的）手脚
entries.en: to move/turn the hands and feet (of a sick person)
entries.notes: L'manos y pies del enfermo'与 H'回脚手'字面可通'回转手脚'，具体动作所指存推断

entries.zh: 撈水；伸手入水搅捞（以手使水凉）
entries.en: to draw/scoop the hand through the water (to cool it)
to walk leaning on a staff/crutch; to carry a walking stick (Sp. bordón)
entries.notes: 西语 bor don 当为 bordón（手杖/拐杖），H'拒拐'疑为'拄拐'之讹写，且 M 声调污损（T99），释义存疑
